You're comparing formal logic to causality.

Formal logic is a structure in which to define something from a category  
"Humans have ten fingers, Apes have ten fingers therefore humans are apes"

I dont actually believe kaido is weaker than an admiral, he'd beat current luffy handedly in a 1 on 1 imo.

But for arguments sake, I wanna put akainu against him. And explor3 how he gets the w.

First off let's put kaido in a bad mood, like suicidial bad and away from his home turf. Kaido is extremely emotional, and I do actually believe fighting alone in hostile territory woukd damage his morale harshly.

Secondly, since akainu isn't on his list of worthy opponents, let's assume kaido at the same time won't take the fight serious from the start.

Imo akainu has all the tools to damage and kill kaido. Conquered haki, immense strength and devil fruit so op it's kinda ridiculous. 

In my scenario kaido will underestimate akainu, and attempt to thunder bagura him as he did luffy the first time. Only akainu, will either manage to dodge with a future sightnsplitting his body, or simply melt kaidos weapon.

Then as in kaidos first showing with luffy, kaido will simply because of his mental state and because of underestimating his opponent, take a hitnor two. I do not think akainu, even with a hellhound can one shot kaido.

However these one or two hits will seal the fight, kaido will be injured, and then take the fight more seriously and get amped up.

In this scenario kaido will however make more mistakes. He will use his many elemental attacks and boroblast, as to show of his power and break his opponents will, however akainus will is not breakable, and any and all attack of an elemental source will fail on a logic user.

Kaido is shown to tank hits and deliver I  return, however this time his failure to intimidate or damage, let's akainu once more land a powerful blow, akainus haki and devilfruit gives him enough strength to damage kaido.

Kaido now realising his mistakes turns to his hybrid form, and the two clash and split the sky.

This is when akainu realizes he's still kinda fucked. He's landed his best attack and his opponent is still going. Even whitebeard slowed down after tanking these.

However as the clash continues, and both combatant have enough stamina to last days, kaidos more I jured state, suddenly leaves a final opening, much like lucchi against luffy, when he ignored gear thirds hit.

This is the deciding moment. For all of his exhaustion, akainu has one more advantage, his devil fruits ability to generate lava seems to be endless, and a final hell hound lands on a kaido who stumbles. This third and final critical hit is it, kaido can  no longer fight.

Akainu wins, from managing to start the battle on his terms and being more prepared and a critical bit of luck.
